name: Dino Polska S.A.
summary: Dino Polska S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates a network of medium-sized grocery supermarkets under the Dino brand in Poland. The company stores offer fresh food products, such as meat, poultry, cold cuts, fruits and vegetables, dairy products, and bread; other groceries, including children's food, breakfast products, ready to eat meals, beverages, candies, snacks, frozen goods, processed goods, oils, grain and bulk products, condiments, and alcohol and cigarettes; and non-grocery products comprising flowers, cleaning agents, sanitary articles, pet food, seasonal products, and small household appliances.
